title: Bind the Windows fixture GIT_DIR depth to the real fixtures, not a hand-measured constant
outcome: On Windows, the fixture-directory budget (67) rests on a hand-measured depth: the deepest fixture GIT_DIR is 133 chars below its directory. That figure is mirrored as DEEPEST_FIXTURE_GIT_DIR_BELOW_DIRECTORY in src/tests/test_temp_paths.rs. A later test that adds a deeper Git fixture can again fail with 'Filename too long' or '$GIT_DIR too big' under a directory the check accepts, while the boundary tests stay green. Bind the bound to where fixture GIT_DIRs are actually created, for example a check in the shared Git-fixture helpers that the GIT_DIR stays within Git's 220 limit with margin, or otherwise make drift visible at run time. No source scans, no timing.
acceptance: Bind the Windows fixture GIT_DIR depth to the real fixtures, not a hand-measured constant is done
